Personal Windows build of OpenToonz, based on OpenToonz 1.8.0.

Versions follow year.month.release: 26.11.1 is the first release of November 2026.

**Install:** extract `OpenToonz.zip` anywhere you can write (not Program Files), then run `OpenToonz\OpenToonz.exe`. Settings, rooms and projects live in `OpenToonz\portablestuff`, so the whole folder can be moved or backed up as is.

## Fixed since 1.8.0

About 170 bugs, from upstream fixes merged after 1.8.0 and from this fork.

### Crashes and freezes
- Freeze when switching scenes after playing sound (Windows audio thread deadlock, a 1.8 regression).
- Crash opening the Cleanup room after loading another scene.
- Crash saving a project that uses $scenepath after unassigning a folder.
- Crash rasterizing vector levels when no OpenGL context is current (icons loaded "At Once").
- Startup crash while restoring the dock layout.
- Crashes in Level Strip Cut with an empty selection, when changing frame with the arrow keys, with a missing tag in PLT/TZP color metadata, and with unsupported image types in the image cache.
- Use-after-free in stroke outline approximation; double delete when adding dynamic fx ports.
- "There is no disk in the drive" dialog when browsing an empty drive.

### Files, formats and projects
- TLV: header, tables, frames and icons fully validated on read; the writer can no longer overwrite other frames, lose data in optimize() or corrupt a file on in-place conversion. Only TLV14 and TLV15 are read (the formats OpenToonz writes).
- BMP colormap heap overflow, 8-bit BMP header size, PNG Adam7 interlacing, PSD with large layers, malformed PLI groups, SVG parser overflows, AVI stream name overflow and error handling.
- Level and output names ending in "_N" no longer lose the number (files could be overwritten).
- Paths coded with the deepest project folder that contains them.
- Studio palettes looked up in the current project after a project switch.
- XDTS import finds levels in nested sub-folders; scene initialization on XDTS load.
- Reload brings the frames added to an image sequence; its undo restores the right images.
- New level size fields follow a change of length unit.
- SVN repository nodes no longer duplicated in the File Browser.
- Safer autosave; portablestuff found beside the application.

### Undo
- Ungroup undone group by group; Group undo restores the stroke order.
- Undo of frame insertions on lettered drawings (2a, 3a) no longer swaps drawings; undo cache ids no longer collide between 1 and 1a.
- Undo of Vector Brush Range strokes on new frames.
- Undo of column deletion keeps fx connections; undo history safe with rapid draw/undo.
- Toonz Raster brush undo and redo kept on the level and frame where the stroke started.

### Drawing, tools and tablet
- Fill Frame Range fills where clicked on held drawings; Frame Range applies the last shape on a single drawing; backward Tape ranges.
- Control Point Editor drift and memory growth while dragging.
- Stylus tilt passed to the brushes; input track timing and ordering fixes.
- Geometry tool thickness on vector levels, Ctrl+Alt brush resizing across level types.
- Toonz Raster resampling right border test.

### Xsheet, sub-xsheets and schematic
- Collapse and explode of sub-xsheets: motion paths, camera parents and groups kept.
- Edit In Place no longer moves the parent scene with the sub-xsheet camera.
- Over Fx layer order scrambled in older scenes.
- Pasting cells into empty columns, smart tab with NxN selections.
- Print Xsheet column headers after the first page.

### Colorization and cleanup
- Preview Cleanup keeps updating after a tool change.
- Merge Tlv Levels with empty cells, different palettes, and its undo.
- Cleanup palette after saving a scene; vector palette order; palette names; default palette for new levels; transparency check on inks only.

### Interface
- Function Editor controls no longer collapse; numeric rollers use the theme colors; vector thumbnails after a GL resize; color calibration without a LUT; expression tokenizer with scientific notation; export level selection.

## Changes
- Removed: scanner, stop motion and camera capture, lip sync, render farm executables, TVPaint JSON and camera track export, SGI and Quantel formats, Record Audio, Brush Presets and Tool Properties panels, Preproduction Board, Finger, Pinch, Pump, Magnet, Bender, Iron, Cutter, Skeleton, Plastic, Hook and Tracker tools, the update check. Scenes using hooks, skeletons or plastic meshes still load and render.
- English only.
- New Toonz Raster levels start with the Animation Color Set palette (black and five lineart colors).
- Default preferences and rooms: pixels, 120 dpi, PNG, compact Xsheet, Always Drag Frame Cell; Xsheet, Drawing, Cleanup, InknPaint and Composite rooms.
